newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki HEX index climbs 0.8 pct to all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki HEX index climbs 0.8 pct to all-time high.

text.p: The Helsinki bourse HEX all-share index opened 0.82 percent higher on Tuesday at an all-time high 3,020.73 points, and soon advanced further.
At 1035/0735 GMT, the HEX was 27.88 points or 0.93 percent higher at 3,025.45 points.
Before the opening, brokers had said they expected shares to open higher following strong overnight gains on Wall Street. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, news@reuters.fi
